[[Tórshavn]], [[Faroe Islands]] | capacity = 5,000 | chrtitle = Chairman | chairman = Edvard Heen | manager = [[Jákup á Borg]] | league = [[Faroe Islands Premier League]] | season = [[2025 Faroe Islands Premier League|2025]] | position = Faroe Islands Premier League, 5th of 10 | website = {{URL|http://b36.fo/}} | current = 2023 B36 Tórshavn season | pattern_la1 = _pumaliga26wb | pattern_ra1 = _pumaliga26wb | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_b1 = _pumaliga26wb | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_la2 = _pumagoal23y | pattern_b2 = _pumagoal24y | pattern_ra2 = _pumagoal23y | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFDD00 | body2 = FFDD00 | rightarm2 = FFDD00 | shorts2 = FFDD00 | socks2 = FFDD00 }} '''B36 Tórshavn''' ({{langx|fo|Bóltfelagið 1936 Tórshavn}}) is a [[Faroe Islands|Faroese]] [[association football|football]] club based in the capital of [[Tórshavn]], playing in the [[Faroe Islands Premier League]], the top tier of Faroese football. B36 Tórshavn has always played its home games in [[Gundadalur]].{{cite web | url=https://football-technology.fifa.com/en/media-tiles/about-football-turf/ | title=About football turf | access-date=26 June 2019 | archive-date=8 June 2019 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190608222139/https://football-technology.fifa.com/en/media-tiles/about-football-turf/ | url-status=live }} Today B36 Tórshavn is among the most successful football clubs in the Faroe Islands, having won the Faroe Islands Premier League 11 times, the [[Faroe Islands Cup|Faroese Cup]] 6 times and the [[Faroe Islands Super Cup|Faroese Super Cup]] once. The club also has a [[B36 Tórshavn (women)|women's section]], which is currently in the process of rebuilding. B36 Tórshavn is one of the biggest football clubs in the [[Faroe Islands]], and is known for playing technical and positive football. In April 2024, [[F.C. Copenhagen]] announced their partnership with B36 Tórshavn.{{Cite web |date=2024-04-14 |title=B36 Tórshavn bliver ny samarbejdsklub |url=https://www.fck.dk/nyhed/b36-torshavn-bliver-ny-samarbejdsklub |access-date=2024-04-09 |website=F.C. København |language=da}}{{Cite web |date=2024-04-09 |title=FCK indgår samarbejde med færøsk traditionsklub |url=https://bold.dk/fodbold/stillinger/superligaen/nyheder/fck-indgar-samarbejde-med-faerosk-traditionsklub |access-date=2024-04-09 |website=bold.dk |language=da}} B36 Tórshavn is known to blend historical success, European exploits, and a youth-to-national-team pipeline."}}
